description:
Four verified correctness defects in the UAT cell status taxonomy and exit
codes, plus one portability crash. All verified on develop @ fc31f3604
(2026-07-10); base 0db7299f3 has no tests/uat changes since.

1. TIMED-OUT OVERWRITTEN BY FAILED (tests/uat/runner.py:270-277): the
   official/throughput validation block sets `status = "failed"`
   unconditionally after `_classify()`, with no `if status == "passed"`
   guard (contrast the correctly-guarded submit downgrade at
   runner.py:258). A timed-out official cell that exported no result JSON
   ends with status="failed", exit_code=124 -- report counts it in
   fail_count not timeout_count (phases/report.py:212-213), cells.jsonl
   records `timed_out: false` (orchestrator.py:592), while
   terminal_state() still derives "timeout" from exit 124
   (phases/report.py:120). One cell, three artifacts, three verdicts.

2. ALL-UNREACHABLE EXECUTE EXITS 0 (tests/uat/phases/execute.py:64-67):
   `ExecuteOutcome.exit_code()` is `all(r.status == "passed" for r in
   self.results)` -- `all([])` is True. Every platform down (or every
   managed compose-up failing, which routes cells into skipped_unreachable
   by design, execute.py:176-186) means zero cells run and
   `make uat-execute` exits 0. Only configs that include the report phase
   catch it (ReportSummary.exit_code checks unreachable_count).

3. FAILED CELLS LABELED submittable (tests/uat/phases/report.py:128-129):
   terminal_state() falls through to `cell.submit_terminal_state` (default
   "submittable") for any failed cell with a resolved result_path.
   Operators triaging by terminal_state misread failures as
   submission-ready. Relatedly the package phase submits result JSONs from
   failed cells: orchestrator.py:422 filters only on result_path presence,
   and official cells resolve result paths regardless of exit code
   (runner.py:246-251 comment says so explicitly).

4. throughput_check NEVER PERSISTED: CellResult.throughput_check
   (runner.py:59-63) -- the one diagnostic the #1094 stream-count guard
   exists to surface -- is not serialized by _write_cells_jsonl
   (orchestrator.py:583-603), is not a REPORT_HEADER column
   (phases/report.py:53-58), and is produced after the cell log closes so
   the failure tail cannot contain it. A stream-count failure leaves
   durable artifacts saying only failed/exit 1.

5. WINDOWS TIMEOUT CRASH (tests/uat/timeouts.py:104): `os.killpg` does not
   exist on win32; spawn handles the platform (`preexec = os.setsid if
   sys.platform != "win32" else None`) but the kill path calls
   `os.killpg` unconditionally and AttributeError is not in the
   `(ProcessLookupError, PermissionError)` catch -- a per-cell timeout
   crashes the whole execute phase instead of classifying the cell
   timed-out. The covering test is skipif-win32 so nothing catches it.

work_units.notes:
tests/uat/runner.py run_cell(): both status="failed" rewrites in the
official/throughput block (successful-read-but-not-ok, and
missing/unresolved result_path) are now guarded by `status == "passed"`,
mirroring the existing submit-classification guard a few lines above.
A timed-out cell with no result JSON now records
throughput_check="not validated: cell timed out" instead of the generic
"no result JSON resolved..." message, and its status/exit_code are left
untouched (stays "timed-out"/124). Added 4 regression tests to
tests/uat/test_runner.py: timeout-preserves-status, missing-result
downgrades a passed cell, an already-failed cell keeps its own exit
code, and the existing downgrade-on-real-throughput-failure behavior is
still exercised (stream-count mismatch on a passed cell).
work_units.summary: Guard the official/throughput status rewrite so timed-out (and any non-passed status) is preserved; only downgrade passed cells

work_units.notes:
tests/uat/phases/execute.py ExecuteOutcome.exit_code(): added an
explicit `if not self.results: return 1` guard before the
`all(status == "passed" ...)` check, since `all([])` is vacuously True.
Extended the existing test_execute_skips_unreachable_platform with an
`exit_code() == 1` assertion (all-unreachable path, zero cells run),
and added test_execute_outcome_exit_code_nonzero_when_every_compose_up_fails
(single-platform sweep whose only managed compose-up fails -> empty
results) plus a direct-construction sanity test
(test_execute_outcome_exit_code_zero_only_when_all_passed) covering
all-passed/one-failed/no-results in tests/uat/test_phases.py.
work_units.summary: ExecuteOutcome.exit_code() returns nonzero when results is empty or nothing passed; regression tests for the all-unreachable and compose-up-all-failed paths

work_units.notes:

`if cell.status == "failed": return f"failed:{cell.submit_terminal_state}"`
between the result_path-is-None branch and the pre-existing

tests/uat/test_report.py (terminal_state() directly + a write_report
row-content check) and one CLI round-trip regression in
tests/uat/test_report_accounting.py exercising the cells.jsonl ->
_handle_report path.
work_units.summary: Stop terminal_state falling through to submit_terminal_state for failed cells: give them an explicit failed-state token; update fixtures and test_report_accounting

SIGTERM->SIGKILL ladder is unchanged when os.killpg is present.
